subject: english
title: Review 7–9 App — Units 7, 8 and 9
subtitle: Checkpoint after Units 7–9 · 8 modules: Academic Language, three unit sweeps (inventions · hobbies · forces), Grammar Round-Up, Listen & Speak, Define It, Can Leo Score?

content: Recall the key vocabulary of Units 7, 8 and 9 — inventions, hobbies, and forces — one unit at a time.
Answer the Student Book listening questions about the invention competition (TR 9.9 and TR 9.10).
Match each definition sentence to its word, then write three definitions and play the guessing game.
Self-check which parts of the three units still need work before the test.
language: Ask and answer with use to / used to about life before an invention.
Define a person with who and a thing or animal with which.
Link two changes with the double comparative the more… the more…
Use the three definition strategies: say what it means, give an example, give the opposite.
